caption: The drawing is rendered in shades of grey and black, suggesting it was done in pencil or graphite on off-white paper. At the center of the composition is a detailed depiction of a large, lidded tankard with a rounded body, a wide, slightly flared base, and a hinged lid topped with a textured thumbpiece shaped with a series of grooves. The handle is robust and curves outward, attached to the body of the tankard near the top and base. To the left of the tankard is a detailed drawing of the handle's end, which features an ornamental face and hands motif. In the bottom right corner of the image, there is a smaller inset drawing showing a side outline view of the tankard, its handle, and the lid with a detailed hinge. The entire drawing is framed with a thin, precise rectangular border and signed at the bottom right with the name "L. Drozdoff."
title: Silver Tankard
